tasks.goal: Administrator can start the rental module with safe defaults and the additive foundation schema.
Integration operator can issue only documented, signed XianGuanJia read requests through a safe transport boundary.
Integration operator can durably preserve XianGuanJia order details and advance a stable order cursor only after successful local persistence.
Integration operator can run a bounded local order-list page with detail refresh, durable run counts, and cursor advancement only after the page succeeds.
Rental operator can convert eligible channel orders and review incomplete records.
Equipment operator can assign a physical device without occupied schedule conflicts.
Authorized admins can operate the V1 workflows in bilingual light and dark modes.
Maintainer can validate the V1 behavior, security boundaries, and migration readiness.
